The combination of AI decision-making with Solana's speed creates new opportunities for automated yield generation.

narratives.summary: Solana Blinks are gaining massive developer traction with 114 active repos, suggesting they're becoming the de facto standard for embedding transactions in social contexts. This represents a fundamental shift toward making DeFi interactions as simple as sharing a link.

narratives.summary: The proliferation of MEV bots, sniping tools, and volume bots indicates that Maximum Extractable Value strategies are being democratized for retail users. This represents a shift from institutional-only alpha to accessible tools that any trader can deploy.

ideas.title: MEV Sharing Protocol
ideas.elevator_pitch: A protocol that pools retail MEV strategies and redistributes profits democratically using ZK compression to make micro-profit sharing economically viable.
ideas.description: Instead of individual bots competing, retail traders contribute strategies to a shared MEV vault. ZK compression enables micro-profit distributions (even $0.10) to thousands of participants. Smart contracts automatically execute the highest-performing strategies, distribute profits proportionally, and use token extensions for transparent, programmable revenue sharing. Leverages Solana's speed for real-time strategy execution and sub-penny profit allocation.
ideas.target_users: Retail traders with <$1K capital who can't afford individual MEV infrastructure but have trading insights
ideas.competitive_advantage: ZK compression makes micro-profit sharing economically viable - impossible on expensive networks
ideas.revenue_model: 2% protocol fee on profits, premium strategy submission fees
ideas.build_guideline: Week 1-2: Core smart contracts with basic profit pooling. Week 3-4: ZK compression integration for micro-distributions. Week 5-6: Strategy submission interface. Week 7-8: Automated execution engine. Week 9-10: Frontend and testing. Week 11-12: Launch with 3 basic MEV strategies.

ideas.title: Blinks Email Gateway
ideas.elevator_pitch: Turn any email into a transaction-enabled interface by converting Blinks URLs into interactive payment buttons for Gmail, Outlook, and enterprise email systems.
ideas.description: A browser extension and API that detects Blinks URLs in emails and renders them as native interactive buttons. Users can approve transactions directly in their email client without leaving their inbox. Supports enterprise SSO, batch approvals, and automated recurring payments. Built for finance teams, subscription services, and B2B payments where email is the primary communication channel.
ideas.target_users: Finance teams at SaaS companies, subscription service providers, B2B payment processors
ideas.competitive_advantage: Blinks' URL-based transaction format makes email embedding possible - other chains require complex iframe solutions that email clients block
ideas.revenue_model: SaaS subscription for enterprise features ($99/month per team), transaction fees (0.1%) for premium integrations
ideas.build_guideline: Week 1: Build Chrome extension that detects Blinks URLs in Gmail. Week 2: Add transaction approval UI within extension popup. Week 3: Integrate with Outlook web client. Week 4: Add enterprise authentication and batch processing features.

ideas.title: MEV Insurance DAO
ideas.elevator_pitch: Protect retail traders from MEV attacks with crowd-funded insurance pools that automatically compensate sandwich victims using ZK-compressed proofs.
ideas.description: A DAO-governed insurance protocol where retail traders pay small premiums to get protected against MEV attacks. When sandwiched or front-run, users submit ZK-compressed proofs of MEV damage and receive automatic compensation from community-funded pools. Uses Solana's 150ms finality to detect MEV in real-time and Token Extensions for programmable insurance payouts.
ideas.target_users: Retail DeFi traders making $100-10K swaps who lose 1-5% to MEV attacks
ideas.competitive_advantage: ZK compression makes proof verification 5000x cheaper, enabling micro-insurance claims that are uneconomical on other chains
ideas.revenue_model: 2% fee on insurance payouts + DAO treasury management fees
ideas.build_guideline: Week 1-2: MEV detection engine using Jupiter API data. Week 3-4: ZK proof generation for sandwich attacks. Week 5-6: Insurance pool smart contracts with Token Extensions. Week 7-8: DAO governance and voting mechanisms. Week 9-10: Frontend for claims submission. Week 11-12: Testnet launch and community pool seeding.

ideas.title: Oracle Prediction PayFi
ideas.elevator_pitch: Instant settlement prediction markets using Solana's 150ms finality where outcomes trigger automatic cross-chain payments via Blinks for supply chain insurance and trade finance.
ideas.description: Real-time prediction markets for business outcomes (shipping delays, crop yields, commodity prices) with sub-second settlement triggering automatic stablecoin payments. Uses Switchboard oracles + ZK compression for 5000x cheaper state storage of millions of micro-predictions. Blinks enable one-click participation from any platform. Token extensions provide confidential betting amounts for institutional players.
ideas.target_users: Supply chain managers, trade finance teams at mid-size importers/exporters needing outcome-based payment automation
ideas.competitive_advantage: Solana's 150ms finality enables real-time settlement impossible on Ethereum; ZK compression makes micro-predictions economically viable at scale
ideas.revenue_model: 2% settlement fee on automated payments, subscription fees for oracle data feeds, white-label licensing to trade finance platforms
ideas.build_guideline: Week 1-2: Deploy basic prediction market contracts with Switchboard integration. Week 3-4: Implement ZK compression for state storage. Week 5-6: Build Blinks for one-click betting. Week 7-8: Add token extensions for confidential amounts. Week 9-10: Create automated payment triggers. Week 11-12: Build dashboard and find pilot customer in trade finance.

ideas.title: Live Coding Arena
ideas.elevator_pitch: Interactive coding challenges where developers solve Solana programming puzzles in real-time with automated testing, leaderboards, and prize payouts using Blinks for instant rewards.
ideas.description: Platform hosting daily/weekly Solana coding challenges ranging from basic SPL token creation to complex DeFi protocol implementation. Developers submit solutions that are auto-tested against hidden test cases. Winners receive SOL/USDC payouts instantly via Blinks. Features live commentary, skill-based matchmaking, and corporate sponsorship integration. ZK compression enables storing thousands of code submissions cheaply.
ideas.target_users: Mid-level developers (1-3 years) wanting to learn Solana through competitive programming
ideas.competitive_advantage: Blinks enable instant prize distribution impossible on other chains; 150ms finality allows real-time testing feedback
ideas.revenue_model: Corporate sponsorship for challenges, premium subscriptions for advanced features, entry fees for high-stakes tournaments
ideas.build_guideline: Week 1-2: Basic challenge submission/testing system. Week 3-4: Blinks integration for payouts. Week 5-6: Leaderboards and user profiles. Week 7-8: Corporate sponsorship dashboard. Week 9-10: Real-time multiplayer features. Week 11-12: Mobile responsiveness and launch.
